paragraphs: The XF 2.0 uses the Ford EcoBoost 2.0 — a 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine. It was fitted to the X250 generation from 2007 until the model's discontinuation in 2015, offering a more efficient petrol alternative to the diesel and larger V6/V8 units in the range. The engine shares its architecture with the wider Ford EcoBoost family used across multiple Ford and Jaguar Land Rover models of that era. The XF 2.0 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ford EcoBoost 2.0 I4 engines for every XF 2.0 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the XF 2.0 from 2023 to present. The Ford EcoBoost 2.0 I4 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older Ford EcoBoost 2.0 I4 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Ford EcoBoost 2.0 I4 rebuild.
